title: FASTEST RC AIRPLANE IN THE WORLD!  Transonic DP -- 545mph!!
summary: A one-minute clip of Spencer Lisenby setting a 545 mph speed record in an RC glider, the Transonic DP, using dynamic soaring. No motor is involved.
why: HN cites it as the surprising example that the fastest RC aircraft is an unpowered glider using dynamic soaring.

quote.text: Here's an RC glider doing 545 mph with that technique
